contract: Compare all 51 forward inputs through the public MOV index and seven edited complete-file controls through index_encoded_range.

The recovering opener also runs every row of the 39-input terminal matrix at its original read, length, seekability and work geometry. The reference uses stream discovery before reading the file or pipe packet list, matching the terminal FFprobe operation.
Fold packets in delivery order. The edited forward and terminal inputs also fold byte position, time base and skip-samples side data.
